messages:
sam: Heads up — noticed a regression causing intermittent 502s on /api/generate in eu-west1. Small guardrail fix ready: commit 6f3a2b4. Low blast radius but user-facing. Need expedited deploy in the 00:30-01:00 UTC change window.

deploybot: Deploy request received for redwood/api:hotfix-6f3a2b4. Canary plan: 10% traffic for 5m -> 100% if healthy. Please ack with +1 (owners/oncall).

olivia (eng-oncall): +1. Ran quick e2e in staging against hotfix image, no failures. sample smoke curl: ```curl -sS -X POST https://staging.api.redwood/api/generate -d '{"prompt":"ping"}' | jq .status``` returned 200.

maria (release-manager): +1 from release. Locking window 00:30-01:00 UTC. Documented risk = header parsing edge case; no DB changes. Add rollback command to thread before deploy.

tony (sre): Rollback ready. Two options: fast revert to main image or rollout undo. Keep both handy.

Rollback (fast revert):
```bash
kubectl set image deployment/api api=redwood/api:main -n prod-eu && kubectl rollout status deployment/api -n prod-eu
```

Rollback (undo):
```bash
kubectl rollout undo deployment/api -n prod-eu --to-revision=42
```

jen (qa): Smoke passed on staging. Will watch 5xx rate, latency p50/p95, and token-encoding errors. I pushed a small lint of the release note here: https://docs.internal/redwood/release-notes/6f3a2b4-draft

deploybot: Scheduled deploy to prod-eu at 00:32 UTC. Canary started at 00:33 UTC — 10% traffic. Observability: https://console.redwood/metrics/prod-eu?job=canary 🔗

sam: Canary running, telemetry looks good so far. No increase in 5xx, KV hitrate stable. memory stable.

olivia: +1 to promote when canary hits 5m and no regressions. Recommend 00:38 promote. :thumbsup:

maria: Hold for 5 more mins to observe KV cache ripple for long-lived sessions. Promote at 00:44 if still clean.

sam: Agreed. Will monitor traces and sampler logs, /cc @tony

deploybot: Promoting to 100% traffic at 00:44 UTC... promotion complete. All pods updated successfully. ✅

tony: Monitoring dashboards green. Temporarily lowered rate-limit thresholds for the endpoint to avoid surge on rollout.

jen: Final smoke after full rollout: passed. No error spikes. Pushed finalized release note: "Fix header parsing causing intermittent 502s in EU region (hotfix)." Link: https://docs.internal/redwood/release-notes/6f3a2b4

maria: Signed off and closing the hotfix window. If we observe anything, use rollback commands above and ping #eng-oncall. Thanks team. :party_parrot:

sam: Thanks everyone — nice quickhand.
